rule: Each 'then' is a property observed on disk or in the verdict (code, state, trust_failures), not a code path. After the pin, a revision is a new file.

scenarios.given: synthetic LAB_TEST lab: founder AUTHENTICATED (stored individual envelope), presented qualification + statement + envelopes, fresh child admission, current trust installed
scenarios.then: state COMMITTED; exactly one ledger line, bound to operation_sha256; home loads; child status AWAITING_INDIVIDUAL_ATTESTATION

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 COMMITTED, child individual envelope stored with store_individual_attestation, child qualification + statement presented
scenarios.then: COMMITTED; the parent's admission verified as spent by its COMMITTED operation, not spent again; the ledger gains exactly one line

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with a signature altered by one bit
scenarios.then: code TRUST_REFUSED with trust_failures containing SIGNATURE_INVALID; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; no operation-log line; ledger, admission records, stored files, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with an issuer absent from the current root
scenarios.then: code TRUST_REFUSED with trust_failures containing UNKNOWN_ISSUER; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; no operation-log line; ledger, admission records, stored files, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with a LAB_OPERATOR key signing the admission
scenarios.then: code TRUST_REFUSED with trust_failures containing SCOPE_NOT_GRANTED; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; no operation-log line; ledger, admission records, stored files, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with an envelope for another lab_id
scenarios.then: code TRUST_REFUSED with trust_failures containing AUDIENCE_MISMATCH; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; no operation-log line; ledger, admission records, stored files, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs with an envelope declaring a root_version above the current root
scenarios.then: code TRUST_REFUSED with trust_failures containing ENVELOPE_FROM_FUTURE_ROOT; outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; no operation-log line; ledger, admission records, stored files, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs, the admitter key REVOKED, or the admission envelope id in revoked_envelopes, in the current root
scenarios.then: code TRUST_REVOKED_BEFORE_CONSUMPTION with trust_failures KEY_REVOKED or ENVELOPE_REVOKED; no operation-log line; ledger, admission records, stored files, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: Sentinel's R8 record presented as is, without envelope or statement
scenarios.then: code ATTESTATION_MISSING; R8 file unchanged; no automatic adoption

scenarios.given: the present-scope qualification and statement, one defect at a time: reviewer_id differs from issuer_id; statement names another record or hash; historical_signature_claimed not literally false; PRESENT scope with campaign_replayed true or campaign_evidence set or historical fields null; FRESH scope with historical fields set or campaign_replayed false
scenarios.then: code STATEMENT_INVALID before PREPARED; ledger, admission records, stored files, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged

scenarios.given: statement envelope missing for a stored or presented qualification
scenarios.then: code ATTESTATION_MISSING

scenarios.given: for each item of the derived list in turn
scenarios.then: code ATTESTATION_MISSING; ledger, admission records, stored files, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged
scenarios.when: that one envelope (presented or stored) is absent

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 inputs
scenarios.then: code ATTESTATION_UNEXPECTED, then ATTESTATION_DUPLICATED; ledger, admission records, stored files, operation logs and homes byte-for-byte unchanged
scenarios.when: an extra valid presented envelope; then one presented envelope duplicated

scenarios.given: a caller attempting to pass a required list or population envelopes
scenarios.then: the argument does not exist or is refused; the list frozen in PREPARED equals the one derived from the lab

scenarios.given: two children of one parent born under the same, then under different qualification records
scenarios.then: both attested as distinct items keyed by (kind, subject, record_sha256); identical records counted once
scenarios.when: a birth whose population holds both

scenarios.given: substitutions one at a time: another record under the same envelope, another child's envelope, a qualification of another parent, a sibling's admission, the same admission presented for another child
scenarios.then: refused by bindings (trust_failures RECORD_HASH_MISMATCH or SUBJECT_MISMATCH, or ADMISSION_NOT_FOR_THIS_BIRTH) before PREPARED; ledger unchanged

scenarios.given: a population descendant whose admission is spent by another operation, by an operation ended FAILED_CONSUMED whose home was not set aside, by a /0 line, or not spent
scenarios.then: code POPULATION_UNAUTHENTICATED; ledger line count unchanged

scenarios.given: a founder without stored individual envelope
scenarios.then: code POPULATION_UNAUTHENTICATED

scenarios.given: a COMMITTED child without individual envelope
scenarios.then: FILIATION_NOT_ATTESTED for the first; the second proceeds and counts the child
scenarios.when: a birth from it; a birth from its parent within ceilings

scenarios.given: a derived list longer than 4*max_population-4, or an envelope file over 16 KiB
scenarios.then: code BUNDLE_TOO_LARGE before any signature check

scenarios.given: g0 population of 5, one founder, every attestation present
scenarios.then: length <= 20 and equal to 4P-3F+3 minus identical records and missing individual envelopes of AWAITING children

scenarios.given: AUTH-01 COMMITTED
scenarios.then: the first returns the established result, nothing written; the second ALREADY_ADMITTED
scenarios.when: the identical call again; then the same child with a new admission

scenarios.given: a stored envelope or statement replaced by a link, a non-regular file, or different bytes
scenarios.then: code STORED_FILE_DIVERGENT; nothing written

scenarios.given: store_individual_attestation with an envelope that does not verify, or for an existing file
scenarios.then: refused; nothing written

scenarios.given: each operation interrupted after DONE D1
scenarios.then: the child admission reported CONSUMED_BY_THIS_OPERATION, never counted as an acceptance; every other frozen item verified again against current trust

scenarios.given: an open operation
scenarios.then: code OPERATION_DIVERGENT; nothing written; the open operation unchanged
scenarios.when: resume changing one presented input at a time (child spec, permissions, budget, diff, presented record, presented envelope, attempt)

scenarios.given: PREPARED, no ledger line
scenarios.then: ABANDONED written; envelope unspent; the new attempt can commit

scenarios.given: DONE D1
scenarios.then: refused; the ledger line remains

scenarios.given: DONE D1, then a direct Supervisor.admit of another child in a test (bypass)
scenarios.then: resume: POPULATION_UNAUTHENTICATED, non-terminal, nothing written; terminate: TERMINATED and FAILED_CONSUMED written, authorization stays spent

scenarios.given: FAILED_CONSUMED after DONE D2
scenarios.then: code ADMISSION_CONFLICT before PREPARED; the new admission envelope is not spent; ledger unchanged
scenarios.when: a new birth of the same child with a new admission

scenarios.given: a log contradicted by a durable fact (DONE D1 without ledger line, ledger line without PREPARED, home without DONE D2)
scenarios.then: code OPERATION_STATE_INCONSISTENT; blocked; nothing written

scenarios.given: Sentinel with one COMMITTED child; the second child's operation interrupted after DONE D3
scenarios.then: COMMITTED; no ALREADY_ADMITTED, no CHILDREN_LIMIT: the operation's own home and admission are excluded from the counts

scenarios.given: DONE D2
scenarios.then: TERMINATED then FAILED_CONSUMED written; the ledger line and admission record remain

scenarios.given: INTERRUPTED_RECOVERED D1 ABSENT
scenarios.then: ABANDONED written; envelope unspent

scenarios.given: after DONE D1: trust policy unavailable, STOP set, L1 busy, an I/O error
scenarios.then: the matching non-terminal code; nothing written; a later identical resume can still commit

scenarios.given: refusal at each check before PREPARED
scenarios.then: outcome REFUSED_BEFORE_DURABLE_EFFECT; no record, line or envelope of the operation

scenarios.given: refusal after PREPARED, before BEGIN D1 (trust refusal)
scenarios.then: outcome REFUSED_AFTER_PREPARE; PREPARED and REFUSED lines; envelope unspent

scenarios.given: an operation log with 60 lines
scenarios.then: OPERATION_LOG_FULL, nothing written; terminate still writes TERMINATED and FAILED_CONSUMED in the reserved lines
scenarios.when: a call that would append a non-terminal line; then terminate

scenarios.given: 256 operation logs
scenarios.then: OPERATION_LOGS_FULL; nothing written

scenarios.given: a torn tail acknowledged, then further lines
scenarios.then: the acknowledged fragment counts as a transition that did not happen; the following lines are read normally; a second non-canonical line without its own acknowledgement is OPERATION_LOG_CORRUPT

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed during the dry run, before PREPARED (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: no log line or a torn tail; with a torn tail, acknowledge_torn_tail then the same attempt can run; nothing spent
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed while writing PREPARED (torn tail) (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: TORN_TAIL blocks the child; after acknowledge_torn_tail the fragment is a transition that did not happen; nothing spent
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after PREPARED (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: PREPARED; an identical resume continues to BEGIN D1; nothing spent
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after BEGIN D1, before the ledger append (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: INTERRUPTED at D1; recover gives ABSENT in the same boot; then BEGIN D1 again; one ledger line in the end
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after the ledger append, before DONE D1 (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: INTERRUPTED at D1; recover refuses PRESENT in the same boot (COLD_READ_REQUIRED); after a reboot, PRESENT; then BEGIN D2; never a second ledger line
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after DONE D1 (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: DONE D1; an identical resume continues to BEGIN D2
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after BEGIN D2, nothing written (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: INTERRUPTED at D2; recover ABSENT; BEGIN D2 again
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after the admission record, before the stored envelopes (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: INTERRUPTED at D2; recover PARTIAL after a cold read; BEGIN D2 writes only the missing files
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after DONE D2 (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: DONE D2; an identical resume continues to BEGIN D3
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after BEGIN D3, before mkdir of the home (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: INTERRUPTED at D3; recover ABSENT; BEGIN D3 again
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after mkdir of the home (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: INTERRUPTED at D3; PARTIAL after a cold read; quarantine_partial_home; BEGIN D3 again
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after mkdir of tasks/ (and again after results/, after j01-lab-memory/) (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: as D3a
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after spec.json (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: as D3a
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after record.json (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: as D3a
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after birth_qualification.json (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: as D3a
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after usage.json, during ActivityStore.create (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: as D3a; the journal checked on a copy outside the lab root, where an empty store file or a WAL whose creating transaction never committed is accepted (§8)
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after admit returned, before the directory fsyncs and byte comparison (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: INTERRUPTED at D3; PRESENT only after a cold read and a complete equal home; then COMMITTED
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after DONE D3 (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: DONE D3; an identical resume writes COMMITTED
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed after COMMITTED (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: COMMITTED; an identical call returns the result, nothing written
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed between QUARANTINE_BEGIN and QUARANTINE_DONE (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: the rename either happened or not; calling quarantine_partial_home again finds the home in exactly one of source and destination, completes the rename if needed and writes QUARANTINE_DONE (refused if in both or neither); nothing deleted
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed during install_trust (after the history line, before the rename) (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: the policy file does not match the last history entry: TRUST_CURRENT_UNAVAILABLE until install_trust is called again with exactly that root, which completes the rename; no birth continues meanwhile
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed during the ledger append (torn ledger line) (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: LEDGER_CORRUPT; every birth refused; manual operator procedure only
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed between SET_ASIDE_BEGIN and SET_ASIDE_DONE (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: as CRASH-Q, with set_aside_terminal_home
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: an authenticated birth or operator action killed during recover, abandon, terminate, acknowledge_torn_tail or store_individual_attestation (SIGKILL in a subprocess)
scenarios.then: at most a torn tail; acknowledge_torn_tail; the action can be repeated; no state goes back before D1
scenarios.when: next call with identical inputs, or the operator action named

scenarios.given: short write or fsync error injected (test only) on the operation log, the admission record, a stored envelope, a home file, and an error raised by Supervisor.admit
scenarios.then: DURABILITY_UNKNOWN; no second fsync of that file; fault in the external fault log; DURABILITY_FAULT in the operation log unless it is the faulty file; BLOCKED_DURABILITY on every later call

scenarios.given: fsync error injected on the ledger
scenarios.then: LEDGER_DURABILITY_UNKNOWN for both: every birth is refused while the ledger fault is recorded
scenarios.when: the step; then a birth of another child

scenarios.given: BLOCKED_DURABILITY with the artefact bytes present
scenarios.then: both refused; no continuation on the presence of bytes

scenarios.given: INTERRUPTED without fault; artefact absent, equal, partial or divergent; same boot and new boot
scenarios.then: same boot: ABSENT accepted, PRESENT and PARTIAL refused COLD_READ_REQUIRED; new boot: PRESENT or PARTIAL recorded; divergent refused RECOVERY_REFUSED

scenarios.given: torn last ledger line; foreign line; duplicate key; link, FIFO or hard link as ledger
scenarios.then: LEDGER_CORRUPT; every birth refused; nothing repaired

scenarios.given: a non-canonical line that is not the final fragment; an acknowledgement naming other bytes
scenarios.then: OPERATION_LOG_CORRUPT; nothing repaired

scenarios.given: admitter key revoked in a root installed after PREPARED, before BEGIN D1
scenarios.then: code TRUST_REVOKED_BEFORE_CONSUMPTION; REFUSED line; ledger unchanged

scenarios.given: revocation installed after DONE D1, then after DONE D2, then after DONE D3
scenarios.then: FAILED_CONSUMED (TRUST_REVOKED_AFTER_CONSUMPTION); no further step; the ledger line kept; never OPERATION_DIVERGENT

scenarios.given: revocation of a COMMITTED individual's envelope (genuine signature)
scenarios.then: status SUSPENDED, record kept; the first refused TRUST_REVOKED_BEFORE_CONSUMPTION with detail FILIATION_SUSPENDED, nothing spent; the second proceeds and counts it
scenarios.when: a birth needing it as parent or ancestor; a birth in another branch

scenarios.given: trust policy missing, unreadable, not regular, pin mismatch, version below the floor, not matching the last history entry, not LAB_TEST
scenarios.then: TRUST_CURRENT_UNAVAILABLE; non-terminal; nothing written

scenarios.given: a birth holding L1
scenarios.then: REGISTRAR_BUSY; never interleaved inside the call

scenarios.given: install_trust with: an equal or lower version; a lower minimum_version; a removed issuer or key; a REVOKED key set ACTIVE; a RETIRED key set ACTIVE; a shrunk revoked_envelopes; a version not above one recorded in an operation log; a changed public_key, introduced_in_root, retired_in_root, issuer_kind or scopes
scenarios.then: TRUST_UPDATE_REFUSED; policy file and history unchanged

scenarios.given: a valid monotonic root
scenarios.then: history line appended; policy file replaced; the next call uses it

scenarios.given: DONE D1, then a benign rotation installed (old admitter key RETIRED after the envelope's version, new key ACTIVE)
scenarios.then: the operation continues to COMMITTED

scenarios.given: DONE D1; a revocation installed touching only an individual of another branch
scenarios.then: the operation continues to COMMITTED; that individual SUSPENDED and counted

scenarios.given: an individual of another branch SUSPENDED before the call
scenarios.then: PREPARED and COMMITTED; the suspended individual counted for ceilings

scenarios.given: a torn or foreign line in trust-history.log
scenarios.then: TRUST_CURRENT_UNAVAILABLE; nothing written

scenarios.given: a SUSPENDED individual
scenarios.then: EXECUTION_SUSPENDED reported; nothing enforced on runs (declared limit)

scenarios.given: trust directory inside the lab root, inside the repository, a link, or mode not 0600
scenarios.then: refused

scenarios.given: two processes, the same child
scenarios.then: one proceeds; the other REGISTRAR_BUSY; one ledger line

scenarios.given: two processes, two children, one place left
scenarios.then: one COMMITTED; the other REGISTRAR_BUSY or its ceiling

scenarios.given: an open operation for child A (PREPARED, DONE D1, INTERRUPTED or BLOCKED)
scenarios.then: code OPERATION_PENDING; nothing written for B; A resumes unaffected
scenarios.when: admit_authenticated for child B in a later call

scenarios.given: STOP set at each read point (start, after PREPARED, before BEGIN D1, before BEGIN D3)
scenarios.then: stops before the next write with LAB_STOPPED; when raised by the registrar inside commit after BEGIN Dk, a BEGIN_CANCELLED Dk line closes it and nothing of step k is written; never terminal; the operation stays at its last DONE line and continues after resume()

scenarios.given: INTERRUPTED_RECOVERED D3 PARTIAL, every present file equal
scenarios.then: QUARANTINE_BEGIN and QUARANTINE_DONE; home moved under admission-quarantine/<operation>/<attempt>; nothing deleted; D3 runs again

scenarios.given: an unexpected file, a link, a divergent byte, or a journal whose copy is in none of the three accepted states
scenarios.then: QUARANTINE_REFUSED; nothing moved, deleted or repaired

scenarios.given: quarantine requested for another operation, without PARTIAL recovery, or with a recorded fault
scenarios.then: refused

scenarios.given: a partial home with a journal
scenarios.then: the original journal files are byte-for-byte unchanged and never opened by SQLite; the check ran on a copy outside the lab root

scenarios.given: FAILED_CONSUMED after DONE D3
scenarios.then: POPULATION_UNAUTHENTICATED; SET_ASIDE_BEGIN and SET_ASIDE_DONE, home moved, nothing deleted; the birth proceeds
scenarios.when: another birth; then set_aside_terminal_home; then the birth again

scenarios.given: admission-ops/, admission-envelopes/, admission-quarantine/ or registrar-admissions/ replaced by a link, or with a mode other than 0700
scenarios.then: LAB_IO_ERROR; nothing written

scenarios.given: before D3, a home for the child already exists: equal to the expected bytes, then different
scenarios.then: equal: treated as the operation's own home under the recovery rules; different: HOME_CONFLICT, blocked, non-terminal, nothing written

scenarios.given: DONE D2, then another individual's home removed in a test (bypass)
scenarios.then: POPULATION_CHANGED; non-terminal; nothing written

scenarios.given: DURABILITY_FAULT recorded for an operation after DONE D1
scenarios.then: TERMINATED and FAILED_CONSUMED written; the ledger line stays; OPERATION_PENDING released

scenarios.given: the operation log itself faulty at PREPARED, no ledger line
scenarios.then: TERMINATED_EXTERNALLY in the fault log with outcome ABANDONED, nothing written to the faulty log; the envelope unspent; OPERATION_PENDING released for other children

scenarios.given: FAILED_CONSUMED home that was run (usage.json, tasks/, results/, inflight.json, journal events)
scenarios.then: moved intact under admission-quarantine/<operation>/terminal; identity files checked; run artefacts, temporary files (usage.json.tmp, tasks/*.json.tmp) and the journal moved without checking their content; a link or unknown name refuses

scenarios.given: any module of colony_lab, colony_pilot, colony_trust, colony_registrar, any worker or task type
scenarios.then: no import of colony_admission

scenarios.given: every task type and sandbox view
scenarios.then: no file of colony_admission and no admission-* or registrar-* path is visible to an individual
scenarios.when: inspect the views and run the sandbox probe

scenarios.given: the operator entry points
scenarios.then: no parameter supplies a boot id; the test seam is unreachable from them

scenarios.given: every test of the slices
scenarios.then: no network, no secret, no runtime import, only LAB_TEST keys derived from public labels

scenarios.given: policy g0, Sentinel with two children
scenarios.then: CHILDREN_LIMIT; no way to raise a ceiling
scenarios.when: a third direct child of Sentinel

scenarios.given: policy g0, a generation-2 parent
scenarios.then: GENERATION_LIMIT

scenarios.given: policy g0, colony budget nearly spent
scenarios.then: COLONY_BUDGET_EXCEEDED
scenarios.when: a birth whose budget exceeds the rest

scenarios.given: each slice HEAD
scenarios.then: 2c926421..., 41b78971..., 97fb6b04... unchanged (existing tripwire tests green)
scenarios.when: recompute Sentinel subject, Sentinel evaluator and pilot evaluator hashes

scenarios.given: admission_code_sha256 over the AST closure
scenarios.then: the controller's qualification reported stale
scenarios.when: change one byte of any file of the closure, including a sentinel_activity module

scenarios.then: moved under admission-quarantine/<operation>/terminal (journaled in the fault log when the operation log is faulty); later births no longer see it

scenarios.given: FAILED_CONSUMED after BEGIN D3 with an identity file whose content is neither a prefix of nor equal to its expected bytes
scenarios.then: QUARANTINE_REFUSED; nothing moved

scenarios.given: a root that retires a key with retired_in_root lower than its own root_version

scenarios.given: an OPERATION_LOG_CORRUPT log of one child
scenarios.then: refused OPERATION_LOG_CORRUPT; nothing written

scenarios.given: DONE D3, then the child run once (usage.json changed), before COMMITTED
scenarios.then: OWN_OPERATION from the identity files only; COMMITTED written; run artefacts kept
